consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was high-energy and featured strong playing from the band, particularly in the second set. While some reviewers noted that the show was not as strong as others around it, many still found it enjoyable and memorable.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 14 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the energy and performance, there were notable comparisons to other shows that left some feeling it didn't quite reach the same heights.
